about: Scenarios for Money slice B (docs/ENGINEERING_SYSTEM.md section 3.2). State is derived from the proof each names. PROTOCOL-class.

scenarios.name: A payment that looks like a bill's end is offered to be judged
given: a bill and a payment of the same amount from the same service, the payment after the bill
when: the review is built from the kept facts
then: one candidate, shown with the bill and the payment, asking whether it was paid
mustNot: a candidate for a payment before the bill, of another amount, or from another service
a candidate that closes anything

proof.check: a bill and the payment that matches it: one candidate, shown with the bill and the payment
it asks in the words that fit: this was paid
a payment before the bill, a different amount, or a different source is not a candidate

scenarios.name: An answer is a label: it opens, closes and changes nothing
given: any answer: Mark paid, Not this or Already paid
then: exactly one event is written, against blinded keys
no loop, commitment or ledger is touched
mustNot: a loop opened or closed by an answer
a second event written
a change on Today

proof.check: the review opens, closes and changes nothing: it names no loop, commitment, ledger writer or journal append outside the one answer
the screen writes exactly one kind of event, in one place
an answer is one event and nothing else is written

scenarios.name: Not this hides that pair only
given: two bills far apart, each with a payment
when: the person says Not this to one pair
then: the other pair is still asked about
the refused bill is an open obligation again, not settled
mustNot: both pairs hidden
the obligation settled by a refusal

proof.check: two bills far apart and a payment for each: two candidates
Not this hides that pair only: the other bill is still asked about, and the refused bill is an open obligation again, not settled
a verdict about another obligation does not hide this one

scenarios.name: Mark paid and Already paid settle an obligation for good
given: a candidate or an open obligation
when: the person answers Mark paid or Already paid, in any order of events, or after a restore
then: its payment is not listed again
mustNot: an answered obligation returning
an answer about another obligation hiding this one

proof.check: Mark paid settles the obligation: neither it nor its payment is listed again
Already paid settles the obligation: it is not offered again
the answers, folded, are the same whatever order they were given in
paid and already paid settle an obligation; not this refuses a pair; missed is counted only on already paid

scenarios.name: An open obligation is asked about for 60 days, not longer
given: a bill with no payment in view
when: it is 60 days old, then 61, then dated in the future
then: 60 is offered; 61 and the future are not
mustNot: a long list of settled old bills answered by habit

proof.check: an obligation 60 days old is offered Already paid
an obligation 61 days old is not
an obligation dated in the future is not offered either
the window is a policy constant, not data

scenarios.name: Already paid measures a missed correlation honestly
given: an open bill and the ledger
then: missed is true only if a movement of that amount and direction sits in the obligation's window and nothing matched it
mustNot: a miss claimed for a movement already matched to another obligation
a miss for another amount, the other way, or outside the 45-day window

proof.check: a movement of that amount in the window from a source nothing matched is a missed correlation
nothing of that amount moved: not missed
a movement of another amount, the other way, or outside the window is not a miss
a movement exactly 45 days after the last reminder is inside the window; the 46th day is not
a movement already matched to another obligation is not a miss for this one

scenarios.name: An answer holds only blinded keys, enums and counts
then: keys, verdict, what was shown, missed, rule name and version, window
mustNot: an amount, a sender, a day, a word, a key that is a name

proof.check: the judged event holds only blinded keys, enums and counts
no amount, sender, day or word is in it
an open answer carries no payment key at all
a key that is not a blinded key is refused: nothing is recorded by name
a verdict must fit what was shown: paid and not this answer a candidate, already paid answers an open obligation
only an answer of already paid can have missed a payment; an open obligation has no payment; what was shown is named

scenarios.name: Precision is reported from 20 answers and never decided on
then: below 20: insufficient sample; from 20: a percentage
mustNot: a threshold that switches behaviour on
a division by zero

proof.check: below 20 answers it says so
from 20 it is reported, as a percentage of the answers
and it rounds to a whole percent
no answers at all is an insufficient sample, not a division by zero
the precision is read by the screen and by nothing that decides
nothing else reads the answers or the precision: the review's rules take what was answered as an argument and never look

scenarios.name: Money owed to the person is judged as arrived, with no open list
given: something owed to the person and money in from the same service
then: a candidate in the words 'Looks like this arrived' / 'Mark arrived'
no Already paid for what is owed to the person
mustNot: Already paid on money owed to the person

proof.check: money owed to the person is asked about as having arrived
and nothing owed to the person is offered Already paid

scenarios.name: The review is built the same from the same facts, and only from what was kept
then: the same items, in the same order
a quiet service's facts left out
'Nothing is kept yet' when there is nothing
mustNot: an order-dependent review
a question about a fact whose key cannot be made

proof.check: the same facts in any order give the same review
candidates come newest payment first, then open obligations newest first
and the open ones, newest bill first: D then C
with nothing kept there is nothing to ask
a fact whose key cannot be made is not listed: a doubt never asks a question the journal cannot hold the answer to
the screen is secure like Recall, reads only the kept facts through the person's marks, and says so when nothing is kept

scenarios.name: The review screen is secure, pure in its rules, and reached only from Money moved
then: secure window, rules with no storage or clock, a screen that is not exported
mustNot: a screen that can be screenshotted
rules that read the clock or storage

proof.check: the rules are pure: no storage, clock, Android or pattern
it is reached from Money moved, and declared not exported
